profile.headline: Software Engineer | Mobile development
profile.summary:
Helping others and guiding them to their goals is what I enjoy doing most. I know how to communicate in a way that motivates and uplifts you to succeed. My strongest trait is making everyone on the team love what they do. 

I’m a full stack Software Engineer, specializing in React Native. I've augmented with a talented mix of mobile & web teams, developing cutting edge apps with frameworks like Expo and Next.js -- from video streaming to cryptocurrency, and a range of healthcare apps.  

Throughout my career, I've managed various in-house and external teams, a summer internship program, and a software engineer apprenticeship program

A proud 2020 Hack.Diversity Fellowship alum, I continue to mentor early career engineers and advocate for alternative education pathways.

Prior to software development, I executed marketing and communications strategies that allowed organizations to connect to their core audiences in innovative ways. I've supported communications for large channels like Airbus (A³ CEO and Project Vahana), launched marketing and digital media campaigns for NYC orgs, and led rebranding efforts.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Augmented alongside RN mobile engineers to update dependencies in outdated code bases, contribute towards dedicated feature work, and help bring life to MVPs. Worked in tandem with design teams to bring needed features to reality. Demoed and QA'd features to ensure functionality and reliability before deployment. Production ready application builds shipped to the respective Apple and Android app stores.

Lead the Summer Apprenticeship program for 3 summers, geared towards the growth of post-college or Bootcamp graduates aiming to gain experience in a professional software engineering environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Building cutting edge mobile apps with React Native.

Additional tools:
- JavaScript, TypeScript 
- RN Elements, RN Paper, RN Reanimated, Restyle, Storybook
- Expo
- GraphQL, Redux, React Query, Firebase
- Jest, Sentry

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Building the best apps with the coolest people. 

- Javascript, React.js, Next.js, Typescript
- React Native (create-react-app & Expo)
- Postgres, GraphQL

positions.title: 2020 Hack.Diversity Fellow
positions.description: Hack.Diversity aims to incubate and mentor STEM talent that will help reverse the underrepresentation of Black and Latino employees in Boston’s innovation economy. Fellowship includes participation in a de.Hackathon (deconstructed Hackathon), career mentorship, networking, Hack.Chats, and summer internship placement.

positions.title: Senior Account Manager
positions.description: Helping Airbus communicate and connect their aerospace innovation efforts to the public in innovative and uniquely personal ways. Specifically supporting communications for: Airbus CTO Paul Eremenko; Rodin Lyasoff CEO of A³, the advanced projects and partnerships outpost of Airbus in Silicon Valley;  Project Vahana, an all electric, self-piloted aircraft that can take off and land vertically.

positions.title: Senior Communications and Brand Manager
positions.description:
- Craft digital communications strategies.
- Manage and assign weekly deliverables. 
- Brand management for multiple accounts.
- Lead daily all-staff meetings.
- Manage digital platforms: Facebook/Twitter/LinkedIn/Hootsuite/Web  
- Graphic design: Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, InDesign, Piktochart
- Manage e-blast distribution: Mailchimp, Salesforce, Constant Contact 
- Conduct media, communications, and brand training sessions.
- Senior copy editor.
- Manage Internship program. 
- Develop internal Camino Wellness initiatives.

positions.title: Brand Manager
positions.description:
- Ensure brand adherence internally, public facing, and for all client deliverables.
- Lead client check-in meetings.
- Lead daily all-staff meetings.
- Manage and assign deliverables.
- Manage digital platforms: Facebook/Twitter/LinkedIn/Web
- Design graphics and infographics: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Canva, Piktochart
- Draft and distribute e-blasts: Mailchimp, Salesforce, Constant Contact
- Prepare and conduct client Media, Communications and Brand training sessions.  
- Senior in-house copy editor.

positions.title: Account Manager
positions.description:
- Client relationship management.
- Develop and curate client social media content.
- Manage client websites (Wordpress, Joomla, Unbounce).
- Draft and distribute e-blasts. 
- Facilitate traditional and digital media training. 
- Pitch and place clients in traditional media outlets.
- Copy editing.

honors.title: Crisis Agency of the Year
honors.description: Bulldog Reporter announced Camino Public Relations as this year’s Crisis Agency of the Year Gold award winner. Bulldog Awards are judged by working journalists who designate Gold awards for entries with “unprecedented high scores,” making this award uniquely prestigious.

honors.title: Silver Bulldog Corporate Social Responsibility PR Award
honors.description: Camino Public Relations won a Silver Bulldog Corporate Social Responsibility PR Award for the “#Tweet4Condoms campaign: How Camino used PR to change Twitter’s advertising policies.” Camino and global condom expert Lucky Bloke launched an awareness campaign regarding Twitter corporate practices that effectively blocked sexual health campaigns from advertising. Within months of the campaign, Twitter announced a change in its long-held policies and reversed its rejection of sexual health-focused condom ads.

volunteerExperiences.description: National nonprofit focused on educating America's youth about HIV/AIDS prevention.
